name: Cain
source:
[spoiler]Cain was an unwanted child who got driven away due to the unique genetic mutation of his eyes.

He grew up in the streets, surrounded with all sorts of wrongdoings and evil people. Not long after, he became a "product of the harsh world." He learned how to steal and smoke at a young age.

During his teenage years, he was involved in brawls and committed rape, but never had he killed a man.

He had a best friend who never left him even during his toughest times, but his world crashed when his best friend got murdered. At that time, he was losing hope and was on the brink of committing suicide.

On a fateful, rainy day, Hexia saw him. To Cain, she was his savior. He came to a realization that aside from his best friend, there were other people who could accept him. Although everything had a condition; Hexia took him in after he agreed to give her his eyes if the right time came.[/spoiler]

During his first weeks working under the d'Andre family, he started out as just a cleaner. Seeing really expensive stuff triggered his side as a thief. But since he was saved due to Hexia's kindness, he managed to stop himself.

He was also deeply attracted to Hexia, and even attempted to rape her. However, his attempt failed when he realized Hexia was rather willing to be stained. At that time, he fell in love with his mistress. He then became loyal and faithful to Hexia.

Trivia:
- His original eye color is gray, but due to a unique genetic mutation known as Alexandria's Genesis, his eyes turned to vivid violet.

[Edited from in-game profile]
